observations.behavior: Replaces direct selector dependency with a guarded lookup using `findMounted()` and an empty fallback; P1.F3.H1 also adds a stable empty list to avoid recomputation while unmounted.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent unnecessary API requests or re-renders when the shared Insight visualization mounts before its dependent Action model has loaded, potentially improving performance and avoiding transient blank states.

observations.behavior: Adds a comment explaining why the guarded lookup is used: "Reading it through findMounted keeps the shared insight logic from fetching every action on mount."
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that this change targets a specific optimization for shared state rather than changing business behavior. This supports tier-2 if the implementation and rationale are visible, but does not demonstrate broader systemic benefit.

observations.behavior: Changes argument type of the allEventNames selector from ActionType[] to import('~/types').ActionType[], then uses NO_ACTIONS as default instead of calling actionsModel.selectors.actions directly.
observations.posthog_connection: Could reduce redundant network calls in dashboard scenarios where multiple insights share an underlying query; however, without tests showing reduced request volume or latency, this remains unverified.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks were examined; no end-to-end test results or performance measurements are provided. The PR description and comments are treated as untrusted and do not establish actual benefit.

review.limitations: Only three hunks were examined; no end-to-end test results or performance measurements are provided. The PR description and comments are treated as untrusted and do not establish actual benefit.
review.reason: The patch demonstrates a bounded correctness and reliability improvement by guarding against premature access to an unmounted model and providing a stable fallback. It also includes relevant checks and documentation explaining why the guarded lookup is used. No evidence exists for broader systemic impact (tier 3).
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to frontend insight rendering and shared state management; could improve responsiveness and avoid unnecessary API requests when action data is unavailable at mount time.
review.uncertainty: Without runtime behavior or adoption metrics, tier cannot be raised above 2.
